column1: # Record entries that the archive cannot match by itself. Generated from the base revision of this release.
# edited-before-base: the file already differed from the record in the base commit; the
#   anchored bytes are in the private working history. base_sha256 is the digest in the base commit.
# recorded-path-rewritten-in-base: the path written in the record was rewritten in the base
#   commit; the anchored file exists under actual_path.
# redacted-private: a Docker image or container list of the build machine from which images and containers
#   unrelated to this study were removed on 2026-10-03 (privacy); the recorded digest is that of the unredacted list.
# outside-repository: the recorded path points outside this repository.
